column1: # Draft G11 (subchapter 6.7): dot-segments in /domain/* rejected before gate (404), /api/held ignores bad Bearer header (200), and GET /domain/shared/<sub> on holder console + ?unit= validation
# 1. Dot-segments in /domain/... return 404 {"error": "not a domain route"} even without Authorization (before gate)
# 2. GET /api/held is open without pass and ignores an invalid Authorization header (X13)
# 3. GET /domain/shared/<sub> on the holder's cluster console reads domain/shared + domain/shared-docs/rev-<rev>, and validates ?unit=
